name: Microsoft Security Operations Analyst

exam.questionCount: 40-60 (typical for Microsoft associate exams; not published)
exam.notes: Leads to Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate. No prerequisite certifications. Proctored; may include interactive components. 100 minutes stated on the certification page; +30 minutes can be requested if the exam is not in your preferred language. Renewal every 12 months via free online assessment. English updated first; localized versions roughly 8 weeks later. Recommended familiarity: Microsoft security/compliance/identity solutions, Microsoft 365, Azure, AI agents and Copilots, Windows/Linux/mobile OS.

objectives.name: Configure automation for Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel
bullets: Configure Defender XDR email notifications (incidents, actions, threat analytics)
Configure Defender XDR alert notifications, including tuning, suppression and correlation
Configure Defender for Endpoint advanced features
Configure rules settings in Defender for Endpoint
Configure custom data collection in Defender for Endpoint
Configure Defender for Endpoint security policies, including ASR rules
Manage automated investigation and response (AIR) in Defender XDR
Configure automatic attack disruption in Defender XDR
Configure and manage device groups, permissions and automation levels in Defender for Endpoint
Create and configure automation rules in Microsoft Sentinel
Create and configure Microsoft Sentinel playbooks

objectives.name: Configure the Microsoft Sentinel SIEM and platform
bullets: Specify Microsoft Sentinel roles
Manage data retention for XDR and Sentinel tables (Analytics, Data lake and XDR tiers)
Create and configure Microsoft Sentinel workbooks
Optimize the Sentinel platform, including SOC optimization recommendations

objectives.name: Ingest data into the Microsoft Sentinel SIEM and platform
bullets: Select data connectors based on data source requirements, including Windows logs and security events
Collect Windows Security events via Windows Security Events via AMA, including data collection rules
Plan and configure Windows Security event collection using Windows Event Forwarding (WEF)
Plan and configure Syslog via AMA and CEF via AMA connectors
Collect Azure activity logs using Azure Policy and resource diagnostic settings
Ingest threat indicators into Microsoft Sentinel
Create custom log tables in the workspace for ingested data

objectives.name: Configure detections
bullets: Create custom detection rules using Advanced Hunting in Defender XDR
Manage custom detection rules in Defender XDR
Configure and manage Sentinel analytics rules: scheduled, NRT, threat intelligence and machine learning
Analyze attack vector coverage using the MITRE ATT&CK matrix
Configure anomalies in Microsoft Sentinel

objectives.name: Respond to alerts and incidents in Microsoft Defender XDR
bullets: Investigate and remediate threats with Defender for Office 365, including automatic attack disruption
Investigate and remediate threats or compromised entities identified by Microsoft Purview
Investigate and remediate alerts and incidents from Defender for Cloud workload protections
Investigate and remediate security risks identified by Defender for Cloud Apps
Investigate and remediate compromised identities identified by Microsoft Entra ID
Investigate and remediate security alerts from Defender for Identity
Investigate and remediate alerts and incidents identified by Microsoft Sentinel
Investigate incidents using agentic AI, including embedded Microsoft Security Copilot
Investigate complex attacks (multi-stage, multi-domain, lateral movement)
Manage security incidents using case management

objectives.name: Respond to alerts and incidents in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
bullets: Investigate device timelines
Perform device actions, including live response and collecting investigation packages
Perform evidence and entity investigation
Investigate and remediate incidents identified by automatic attack disruption

objectives.name: Investigate Microsoft 365 activities to identify threats
bullets: Investigate threats using Microsoft Purview Audit
Investigate threats using Content search in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery
Investigate threats using Microsoft Graph activity logs

objectives.name: Detect threats by using Microsoft Defender XDR
bullets: Identify the appropriate table to use in a KQL query
Identify threats using Kusto Query Language (KQL)
Create Advanced Hunting queries
Interpret threat analytics in Defender XDR
Create hunting graphs, including blast radius
Analyze relationships between entities using Sentinel Graph

objectives.name: Detect threats by using the Microsoft Sentinel platform
bullets: Create and monitor hunting queries
Create and manage KQL jobs in the Sentinel data lake
Create and manage summary rule tables for querying
Hunt for threats using Notebooks, including connecting to the Sentinel MCP Server

keyTerms: Sentinel roles (Reader, Responder, Contributor, Automation Contributor)
caveats: Outline fetched from learn.microsoft.com on 21 Oct 2026; the new 'Skills measured as of October 21, 2026' version went live that same day (change log: only 'Ingest data into the Microsoft Sentinel SIEM and platform' marked Minor; other areas no change). Localized exams lag ~8 weeks, so non-English candidates may still see the prior version. Question count is not published (40-60 is the typical Microsoft range). Bullets are paraphrased, not verbatim. Applied Skill: 'Defend against cyberthreats with Microsoft Defender XDR' (assessment APL-5004, aligned course SC-5004) exists on Microsoft Learn with no retirement notice seen; it is a hands-on lab assessment covering: configure a Defender XDR environment, manage devices with Defender for Endpoint, manage incidents in Defender XDR, manage investigations on an endpoint, and Advanced Hunting with KQL. It overlaps SC-200 D1.1, D2.1-2.2 and D3.1 but excludes Sentinel; it is not a prerequisite for SC-200. Lab relaunch cooldown is 72 hours.
